cost_profile.label: Standard PSX (commission 0.15%×2, slippage 0.15% round-trip, CGT 15% on gains)
cost_profile.description: Commission 0.15% per side (×2 for entry+exit = 0.30% round-trip). Slippage 0.15% applied ONCE per round-trip (not per fill). CGT 15% on positive gross gains (Pakistan Finance Act). Matches investment-simulator.ts + signal-stats/route.ts.

sensitivity.label: High-slippage PSX (commission 0.15%×2, slippage 0.50% round-trip, CGT 15% on gains)
sensitivity.description: Same as standard_psx but slippage 0.50% (3.33× higher). Matches backtest.ts. Used as a conservative-cost sensitivity result, NOT the primary.

walkforward_trading.signal_policy: long-only BUY when predicted return > +1% threshold. Negative forecasts = HOLD (not traded). No short-selling (PSX short-sale execution not supported).
limitations: Long-only strategy. Negative forecasts = HOLD (not traded). n_negative_forecasts_not_traded reports the count.
Fixed notional per trade (PKR 100,000). No portfolio-level capital allocation, compounding, leverage, or cash-availability model. Multiple same-date entries are NOT portfolio-managed.

Portfolio-level metrics (ROI, Sharpe, Sortino, max drawdown) are UNAVAILABLE — would require a chronological portfolio-equity curve with capital allocation rules. Trade-level net P&L is reported instead.
Signal threshold (+1%) is FIXED and was NOT tuned on final-test performance. ATR/SL/TP distances use the documented fallback convention (1.5/1/2/3 × ATR) — NOT tuned on final-test.

The standard_psx cost profile (slippage 0.0015) is the primary. The high_slippage_psx sensitivity (0.005) is reported separately. Selection by documented convention (majority of simulators), NOT by profitability.
Same-stock holding windows do NOT overlap (sample_step=50 > max horizon=21). Cross-stock same-date entries are allowed but treated as independent fixed-notional trades (no portfolio management).

This is a GENUINE out-of-sample ML trading simulation using the stored pilot25 predictions. It is DISTINCT from: (a) the forecast-quality evaluation (walk_forward_latest.json), (b) the signal-stats current-signal replay, (c) the backtest.ts technical-rule strategy. Do not conflate.

The execution-data fingerprint verifies the OHLCV bars haven't changed since the pilot25 run. The forward-return verification reconstructs actual_5d/10d/21d from bars + compares to stored values (tolerance 1e-6).

weaknesses: All 5 existing models have profit factors 1.3-1.5 on final-test — modest, not strongly predictive.
High win rate does NOT imply high net P&L (trailing/scale-out have 60%+ win rate but negative net P&L — they cut winners short).
fixed_first_hit (lowest win rate ~48%) has the BEST net P&L — suggests the target structure (TP3) matters more than exit policy complexity.
The +1% BUY threshold produces ~27% of predictions as BUY (1089/4000 in Task 78) — a reasonable candidate rate but not highly selective.
Model predictions have weak ranking power (profit factors barely above 1.0) — the edge is small + uncertain.
25 decision dates × 24 stocks is a small sample — results are exploratory, not significant.
limitations: This audit uses the pilot25 universe (25 stocks) — a small, liquidity-selected sample. Results may not generalize to the broader PSX.
Feature correlations are computed on the full dataset (not point-in-time) — they indicate redundancy, not predictive power.
